countries.notes: Bouldeer covers only 12 states (CA, CO, MA, IL, TX, WA, NY, NV, GA, UT, TN, AL). In indoorclimbinggym.com the other 39 states+DC hold ~401 of 779 gyms (~51%): FL 29, NC 28, OR 26, PA 26, OH 23, NJ 23, VA 23, MI 20, MN 16, AZ 16, WI 14, IN 14, MO 12... Inside the 12 covered states Bouldeer 312 vs directory 378 (directory is a floor; CBJ-commercial suggests ~15-30% more). Biggest gap is geographic (whole states missing), not depth. Mountain Project figures came through a summarising fetch tool and are approximate. Definitions: CBJ counts commercial gyms (nearly all have bouldering); mid includes public community/university walls. Lead URLs are only those seen in search results; blank = not confirmed.
